World Labs’ new Atlas model can reconstruct an entire 3D environment from just one photo, then let you control the camera and explore it from completely new angles.

What you're seeing IS NOT an AI video, it’s an entire fully explorable world.

You can also give it multiple images and it can combine them into one larger, navigable scene.

What would you build with this?
